items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: I had McGee, George, myself... It was Boyk, myself, and George Lewis, and McGee.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Well, who'd you have in the band now?
George Lewis McGee on drums. He's in California.
Now, that's not Herb Moran's brother. That's another McGee. Another McGee. Yeah, Herb's brother's dead.
